Resolves #20918

Two comparison guides join `learn/comparisons/`: `NeoVsAgGrid.md` and `NeoVsBryntum.md`. Each opens with the engine and its second hemisphere, carries one top-down diagram, cites vendor facts from public pages with their read date, and lists what Neo.mjs does not do today. Both are registered in `learn/tree.json`, in the overview's list and in the `PRIORITIES` map.

Evidence: L3 (the portal and two examples on a dev server, the Neural Link against both examples) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2: documents and their registration). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 the two guides: identity opening, one render-checked diagram each, verified benchmark and architecture facts, dated vendor pages, trade-off sections | outside-CI: the portal on the dev server at a 1440 px viewport. `#/learn/comparisons/NeoVsAgGrid`: one SVG, `aria-roledescription="flowchart-v2"`, 7 nodes, 2 subgraphs, drawn at scale 1.00 (673 px in a 737 px column). `#/learn/comparisons/NeoVsBryntum`: `flowchart-v2`, 6 nodes, 1 subgraph, scale 1.00 (418 px). Every benchmark number is from `COMBINED_BIG_DATA_REPORT.md` at `neomjs/benchmarks` commit `4300c48`, generated 26 Oct 2026. The planning facts are read from `src/timeline`, `src/scheduler` and `src/gantt` at `c78adac361`; `src/board` is absent, so no board is named. Eleven vendor pages, each linked in the guides with the date 15 Nov 2026. |
| AC-2 registration, link and whitespace checks, SEO verifier, no generated file | outside-CI: `node buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` → OK, 363 links (343 on `dev` plus 20); `node buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` → exit 0. A generator run into a temporary file (`generate.mjs -f seo-json`) yields 173 routes, the 171 of `dev` plus the two guides, with titles and descriptions taken from their frontmatter and untruncated (73 characters; 143 and 142). No generated file is in the diff. The verifier clause is delta 2. |

## Deltas from ticket

1. `PRIORITIES` lives in `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`. `seoJson.mjs` is untouched: the search titles come from `seoTitle` and `seoDescription` frontmatter, which it already reads.
2. `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` cannot pass on a branch that adds a guide without the generated file, because its first check is the parity of `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`. It already fails on `dev` at `c78adac361` over two `lastmod` values (`MainThreadAddons`, `CanvasArchitecture`). That file is pipeline output, so it stays out of the diff and the clause moves to Post-Merge Validation.
3. Every Bryntum component has a free MIT Community tier today (its pricing and licensing pages). The planning guide therefore compares the three tiers and does not present the licence as the difference.
4. AG Grid and Bryntum announced a partnership in November 2025. Both guides state it and link each other.
5. Both guides rank 0.8 in `PRIORITIES`, above the six library comparisons at 0.7: they answer the product-name queries of the Nov 14 Search Console audit on #20671.
6. The overview lists them as a second group, component suites.
7. Each guide carries a first-hand passage about what I ran through the Neural Link (see Test Evidence). The ticket does not ask for it; the guide bar's grounding rule does.

One dated dependency: the guides name the timeline, scheduler and Gantt views. They are on `dev` and ship with the cut planned for Nov 23.

Identity surface, framing only: both openings are projections of the apex in `neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model`, in the pattern of PR #20988, which touches `Overview.md` in another hunk. A cross-family review is required for this class. Review focus: the planning feature list against the source, the benchmark quotes against the report, and the vendor sentences against the linked pages.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the pre-commit hook ran the secrets, whitespace and relative-link checks.

## Test Evidence

- Portal render: the two routes in the AC-1 row, read in the dark theme only.
- Neural Link on `examples/grid/bigData`: `list_stores` returned nine stores; `inspect_store` on `neo-store-1` returned 20,000 records, `autoInitRecords: false`, its filters, sorters, listeners and first record, while the page held 32 rows.
- Neural Link on `examples/gantt/basic`: `call_method` `moveTask('survey', {endDate: '2026-11-11T00:00:00Z'})` on `neo-gantt-1` returned a receipt with two `cascaded` entries (`survey-design`, `design-materials`) and `cycles: []`. A second call restored the dates.
- Not done: a benchmark re-run. The three scroll rows of the 26 Oct report predate a fix merged the same day, and the guide says so. A run on an uncontended machine would replace them.
- Not checked: the light theme and a phone-width viewport.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After the next `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo` run, `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` holds `/learn/comparisons/NeoVsAgGrid` and `/learn/comparisons/NeoVsBryntum`, and `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passes.
- [ ] Both routes render on neomjs.com after the next deploy.
- [ ] The planning guide links the two examples on GitHub because they are not deployed yet; after the v14 deploy the links can point at the live examples.
